description: Free. Starts a staged story film run from a card (cardId from list_story_cards, or your own `card` object with the same fields as get_story_card returns) for the brand's product: it writes the outline, nothing is billed. Then call advance_story_film to run each stage: screenplay, boards (cast, location and a board per act), clips, final cut. autoRun:true runs every stage after the screenplay straight through once its price is shown; the default asks before each paid stage.

autoRun.description: true = stop once after the screenplay with the price of the rest, then run it all

card.description: your own card instead: {id, style, title, logline, lengthSeconds:{min,max,default}, beats:[{role, share, must}], ...}; shares add up to 1

creator.description: the hero: a saved creator id or name from list_creators (live-action styles)

lengthSeconds.description: total length, 20-240 seconds; default the card's own. A named length is used as asked

location.description: where it happens, in words; default the card's location rule

product.description: the product that turns the story, in words (default: the brand's own)

resolution.description: render tier; default the standard tier

rival.description: the rival or second character, in words

name: start_story_film
title: Start a story film
